498:    "scripts": {
541:        "si": [
543:            "drush site:install --yes"
===
    "scripts": {
        "cde": [
            "drush pm:install config_devel --yes",
            "rm -rf profile/config",
            "drush cde openculturas",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_faq/config/install",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_faq/config/optional",
            "drush cde openculturas_faq",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_discussions/config/install",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_discussions/config/optional",
            "drush cde openculturas_discussions",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_map/config/install",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_map/config/optional",
            "drush cde openculturas_map",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_section/config/install",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_section/config/optional",
            "drush cde openculturas_section",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_openstreetmap/config/install",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/modules/openculturas_openstreetmap/config/optional",
            "drush cde openculturas_openstreetmap",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/themes/opcult/config/install",
            "rm -rf profile/config/custom/themes/opcult/config/optional",
            "drush cde opcult"
        ],
        "drupal-ai": "Drupal\\AiBestPractices\\Console\\AiBestPracticesApplication::runFromComposer",
        "export-content": [
            "drush pm:install default_content --yes",
            "rm -rf web/profiles/contrib/openculturas-profile/modules/custom/openculturas_content/content",
            "drush default-content:export-references node --folder=profiles/contrib/openculturas-profile/modules/custom/openculturas_content/content",
            "drush default-content:export-references media --folder=profiles/contrib/openculturas-profile/modules/custom/openculturas_content/content",
            "drush default-content:export-references menu_link_content --folder=profiles/contrib/openculturas-profile/modules/custom/openculturas_content/content",
            "drush default-content:export-references taxonomy_term --folder=profiles/contrib/openculturas-profile/modules/custom/openculturas_content/content",
            "drush pm:uninstall default_content --yes"
        ],
        "info_file_normalizer": "@php scripts/info_file_normalizer.php",
        "php:cs": "phpcs -s",
        "php:cs-fix": "phpcbf",
        "php:lint": [
            "parallel-lint --colors --show-deprecated -e php,module,install,profile,theme profile"
        ],

observation.command: cd /workspace && grep -n '"si"\|"si-\|site:install\|"scripts"' composer.json | head; echo "==="; sed -n '/"scripts"/,/^    }/p' composer.json | head -40
